text: {"lessons":["Selling winners for quick reassurance can leave me buying them back later; I should sell only when the investment outlook or portfolio needs have changed.","Repeatedly trading the same stocks at changing prices risks turning short-term price moves into costly decisions; I should use a clear plan and avoid chasing.","Periods 7–10 showed that account values can recover without trading; patience and holding can be deliberate choices, not inaction."]}
